## Leading Stainless Steel Process Equipment Manufacturer

At Cedarstone Industry, we work in tandem with our clients to arrive at truly **turn-key solutions
for commercial food, beverage, extraction, and brewery applications**. As an industrial **stainless
steel process equipment manufacturer**, we provide equipment such as stainless vessels, [stainless
steel mixing tanks][134], stainless aseptic tanks, [crystallization reactors][135], extraction
system, [stainless storage tanks][136], etc. Additionally, we go above and beyond by providing
complete automation turnkey solutions for our clients.

[Learn More About Us][137]
[[IMG 2053b scaled][IMG 2053b scaled]][138]

### We’re Customer First

We augment our exhaustive list of services with a truly comprehensive catalog of **stainless steel
process equipment, extraction systems, and brewing systems**. This includes custom mixing tanks,
storage, vessels, tanks, [food processing][139], and other [stainless brewing equipment][140]. **At
Cedarstone, the customer truly comes first**. We lead in the industry with both competitive prices
on stainless steel tanks and fittings as well as extensive customization for the products we
provide. As an extraction equipment, [brewery tank][141] and stainless food processing equipment
manufacturer, we know what your business needs.

[Our Customers][142]
[[IMG 1204][IMG 1204]][143]

### UL and 3A Certified, ASME Partner

As a UL and 3A certified manufacturer, Cedarstone strictly follows UL508A – industrial control
panels standard, and UL 698A- Industrial Control Panels Relating to Hazardous (Classified)
Locations. We also adhere to the UL Standard 508A, Industrial Control Panels Canadian Standard CSA
C22.2 No. 14, Standard for Industrial Control Equipment. We also strict follow ASME Boiler and
Pressure code to design & manufacture stainless steel tanks, fittings, and pressure vessels.

We understand that every industry has its own requirements; there’s no one-size-fits-all approach
for stainless steel brewing, [mixing][144] or storage equipment. From choosing between single-wall
and jackets tanks, or customizable tank capacities, we have it all! **Contact us for any queries
regarding stainless brewing equipment product specifications.**

[Contact Us][145]

## 6 Reasons to Choose Us as Your Stainless Steel Process Equipment Manufacturer


### Installation Experience

We’re not only a stainless tanks and system manufacturer that specializes in stainless steel process
equipment, we install them too. Numerous worldwide installation project record; Unsurpassed
installation experience; Excellent quality control & progress supervision.


### Manufacturing Capacity

We have an over 300,000-square-foot plant that houses a comprehensive world-class brewery tanks
manufacturing facility. We have skilled workers and engineers and a 100-foot-high ceiling production
workshop. We are capable of manufacturing up to 16 feet OD, 5000 bbls vessel.


### ASME Standards

We strictly follow ASME’s (American Society of Mechanical Engineers) stainless steel tank design and
3A fitting standards.


### Quality Assurance

20 years of experience in industries with high sanitation standards. Our complete line of
manufacturing and quality control apparatuses ensure the quality of our products.


### Customer Base

As a stainless process equipment and brewery tanks manufacturer, we are proud that our food
processing systems have been used by Heineken, Coca-Cola, Global Beerco USA, AB InBev, ThyssenKrupp,
Indonesian Orang Tau, Mongolian Haanjims, Tsingtao Brewery, and other firms in dozens of countries.


### Working Culture

Cedarstone maintains a professional and humble working philosophy. Your satisfaction with your
stainless steel vessels, mixing, storage tank, extraction, brewing, and processing system is our #1
goal.

## Our Certifications


[**Contact us for a quote!**][146]

## Certified stainless steel process equipment for the most demanding customers

At Cedarstone Industry, we take pride in our commitment to producing **high-quality stainless steel
process equipment** such as tanks, mixers, fittings, and other components that meet rigorous
industry standards. When designing our products, we strictly follow the American Society of
Mechanical Engineers (ASME) Boiler and Pressure Vessel code. This allows us to ensure that all our
design, manufacturing and testing processes meet widely recognized safety and quality standards.

In addition to the ASME code, we also adhere to 3A fitting standards. The 3A Sanitary Standards are
a set of guidelines for the design, manufacturing, and installation of equipment used in the food,
beverage, and pharmaceutical industries. Thanks to it, we’re able to ensure that our stainless
solutions are designed and manufactured to prevent contamination and guarantee the safety and
quality of products.

[Learn More About Us][147]
[[cedar first frame][cedar first frame]][148]

## Over 20 years of experience in industries with high sanitation standards

**With over 20 years of experience as a stainless steel process equipment manufacturer** for the
food, beverage, extraction, and brewery industries, we have developed a deep understanding of the
needs and requirements of each of these sectors. We recognize the importance of meeting high
sanitation standards, that’s why we strive to continuously refine our processes to ensure our offer
meets the expectations of even the most demanding customers.

Over the years in the industry, we have learned how to design and manufacture stainless steel
process equipment that is durable, reliable, and easy to clean.

Our team of experts has the knowledge and experience necessary to provide turn-key solutions for a
variety of industries. We work closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and
requirements in order to develop custom solutions that will facilitate their everyday work.

[Our Customers][149]
[[57 21][57 21]][150]

## Professional stainless steel process equipment manufacturer for your needs

Cedarstone Industry is your **professional and accessible stainless steel process equipment
manufacturer** ready to provide you with systems and tanks tailored to your needs. Thanks to working
with clients from various sectors, we have developed a deep understanding of their needs and
requirements. Thanks to it, we’re able to provide companies with reliable solutions for different

[[IMG 2053b scaled][IMG 2053b scaled]][138]

### We’re Customer First

We augment our exhaustive list of services with a truly comprehensive catalog of **stainless steel
process equipment, extraction systems, and brewing systems**. This includes custom mixing tanks,
storage, vessels, tanks, [food processing][139], and other [stainless brewing equipment][140]. **At
Cedarstone, the customer truly comes first**. We lead in the industry with both competitive prices
on stainless steel tanks and fittings as well as extensive customization for the products we
provide. As an extraction equipment, [brewery tank][141] and stainless food processing equipment
manufacturer, we know what your business needs.

[Our Customers][142]
[[IMG 1204][IMG 1204]][143]

### UL and 3A Certified, ASME Partner

As a UL and 3A certified manufacturer, Cedarstone strictly follows UL508A – industrial control
panels standard, and UL 698A- Industrial Control Panels Relating to Hazardous (Classified)
Locations. We also adhere to the UL Standard 508A, Industrial Control Panels Canadian Standard CSA
C22.2 No. 14, Standard for Industrial Control Equipment. We also strict follow ASME Boiler and
Pressure code to design & manufacture stainless steel tanks, fittings, and pressure vessels.

We understand that every industry has its own requirements; there’s no one-size-fits-all approach
for stainless steel brewing, [mixing][144] or storage equipment. From choosing between single-wall
and jackets tanks, or customizable tank capacities, we have it all! **Contact us for any queries
regarding stainless brewing equipment product specifications.**

[Contact Us][145]

## 6 Reasons to Choose Us as Your Stainless Steel Process Equipment Manufacturer


### Installation Experience

We’re not only a stainless tanks and system manufacturer that specializes in stainless steel process
equipment, we install them too. Numerous worldwide installation project record; Unsurpassed
installation experience; Excellent quality control & progress supervision.


### Manufacturing Capacity

We have an over 300,000-square-foot plant that houses a comprehensive world-class brewery tanks
manufacturing facility. We have skilled workers and engineers and a 100-foot-high ceiling production
workshop. We are capable of manufacturing up to 16 feet OD, 5000 bbls vessel.


### ASME Standards

We strictly follow ASME’s (American Society of Mechanical Engineers) stainless steel tank design and
3A fitting standards.


### Quality Assurance

20 years of experience in industries with high sanitation standards. Our complete line of
manufacturing and quality control apparatuses ensure the quality of our products.


### Customer Base

As a stainless process equipment and brewery tanks manufacturer, we are proud that our food
processing systems have been used by Heineken, Coca-Cola, Global Beerco USA, AB InBev, ThyssenKrupp,
Indonesian Orang Tau, Mongolian Haanjims, Tsingtao Brewery, and other firms in dozens of countries.


### Working Culture

Cedarstone maintains a professional and humble working philosophy. Your satisfaction with your
stainless steel vessels, mixing, storage tank, extraction, brewing, and processing system is our #1
goal.

## Certified stainless steel process equipment for the most demanding customers

At Cedarstone Industry, we take pride in our commitment to producing **high-quality stainless steel
process equipment** such as tanks, mixers, fittings, and other components that meet rigorous
industry standards. When designing our products, we strictly follow the American Society of
Mechanical Engineers (ASME) Boiler and Pressure Vessel code. This allows us to ensure that all our
design, manufacturing and testing processes meet widely recognized safety and quality standards.

In addition to the ASME code, we also adhere to 3A fitting standards. The 3A Sanitary Standards are
a set of guidelines for the design, manufacturing, and installation of equipment used in the food,
beverage, and pharmaceutical industries. Thanks to it, we’re able to ensure that our stainless
solutions are designed and manufactured to prevent contamination and guarantee the safety and
quality of products.

Over the years in the industry, we have learned how to design and manufacture stainless steel

Our team of experts has the knowledge and experience necessary to provide turn-key solutions for a

# Amerimax Rain-Carrying Solutions

## Gutter Systems

Gutter systems are your first line of defense against uncontrolled rainwater that can damage your
home. Amerimax gutter systems provide everything you need to keep your home and family safe.

[Learn More][31]

## Gutter Protection

#### Keep Rainwater Flowing Through Your Gutter System

Gutter protection, including gutter guards, shields and downspout covers, help keep tree debris and
leaves from clogging your gutters so that rainwater flows freely away from your roof and foundation.

Amerimax offers gutter protection products for all gutter and downspout types.

[Learn More][32]

## Rainwater Diversion

#### Move water away from your foundation

Stop drowning your flower beds and plants. Prevent water from flowing into your basement. Divert the
flow of downspout rainwater away from your home’s foundation with Amerimax.

## Industries

[

### Aquaculture

How can you improve your aquaculture operations? Get a comprehensive overview of our advanced,
corrosion-free piping solutions designed for optimal water quality, temperature control, and
nutrient distribution. Learn how our innovative technologies support the health and growth of
aquatic organisms, enhance productivity, reduce maintenance, and promote sustainable farming
practices.
Show more
][124]
[

### Battery Production

With over 60 years of experience, GF Industry and Infrastructure Flow Solutions provides
industry-leading flow solutions for sustainable battery production. Our plastic pipes are tailored
for battery manufacturing and other industrial applications, offering corrosion-free alternatives to
traditional metal solutions.
Show more
][125]
[GF BFS Buildings (1000 x 1000 px) - 1]
[

### Buildings

Discover our solutions for plumbing, radiant heating and cooling, and local heat distribution. 

Show more
][126]
[

### Chemical Process

Enhancing plant performance, safety, and risk management while meeting ESG targets is crucial for GF
piping systems in the chemical industry. Our corrosion-free piping and automation solutions,
including valves and measurement tools, offer cost-effective processes. Learn more about our
high-quality, tailored portfolio.
Show more
][127]
[

### Data Centers

GF delivers innovative mission critical cooling systems for data centers, providing complete
commercial cooling system solutions from chiller to chip. Our systems support CWS, FWS, and TCS
applications across key equipment like chillers and cooling towers. Built for extreme conditions and
drastically reducing energy consumption and energy loss, thus furthering energy efficiency and
environmental contribution.
Show more
][128]
[

### Energy

Modular piping solutions for multiple energy applications. Our engineering capabilities help
optimize space and reliability while meeting the sector's stringent operational demands. Read more.
Show more
][129]
[

### Food and Beverage

Food and Beverage producers encounter rising costs, strict regulations, and complex processes. GF
Industry and Infrastructure Flow Solutions provides tailored, corrosion-free piping solutions to
address these challenges. Our energy-efficient systems enhance quality, minimize downtime, and
improve efficiency, ensuring compliance and sustainability.
Show more
][130]
[

### Gas Utilities

Keep your flow under control - Our optimized gas solutions help you lower cost and increase safety.
Show more
][131]
[

### Hydrogen

Corrosion-free and safe polymer piping systems for long-lasting hydrogen applications. Embark on the
captivating journey of the universe's smallest molecule, accompanying it from production to
distribution to usage.
Show more
][132]
[

### Leisure and Life Support Systems

GF Industry and Infrastructure Flow Solutions specializes in providing precise measurements for
essential water parameters and low leach-out, light-weight plastic piping solutions. Read more here.
Show more
][133]
[

### Life Sciences

From high purity recirculating laboratory water and special waste to process cooling water... we
have piping system solutions for you.
Show more
][134]
[

### Marine

GF Industry and Infrastructure Flow Solutions is committed to developing safe and sustainable marine
piping solutions for the transport of water, gas, and chemicals at sea. Their solutions utilize
lightweight, corrosion-resistant thermoplastic pipes that are easy to install, reliable, and meet
industry standards.
Show more
][135]
[

### Microelectronics

GF Industry and Infrastructure Flow Solutions supports semiconductor fabs with sustainable water
solutions for over 30 years. Our mission-critical offerings exceed industry standards in quality and
delivery speed, ensuring environmental sustainability. Read more.
Show more
][136]
[

### Mining

Discover GF Industry and Infrastructure Flow Solutions' sustainable solutions for mining. Our
corrosion-resistant and cost-efficient solutions ensure safety and efficiency in a variety of mining
applications.
Show more
][137]
[

### Water Industry

Discover our state-of-the-art Valve and Measurement Solutions for sustainable and reliable water
management. Leverage the superior characteristics of corrosion-free and lightweight thermoplastics
and our interoperable and modular products to improve water quality.
Show more
][138]
[

### Water Utilities

An efficient and resilient water network plays a pivotal role in creating a sustainable future. We
ensure the smooth flow of water from its source through the grid to the tap.
Show more

## We're installing the lifelines for the buildings of tomorrow.

Viega is a global market leader and a fifth-generation family company. Guided by our values, we have
the courage to develop innovative and pioneering technologies – and we've been revolutionising
installation technology for 125 years. We want to continue to develop and grow – every day. We
strive to turn spaces into living rooms. Our more than 5,500 employees around the world have
committed to this vision. We constantly develop new products and services and always driven by our
motto: **Viega. Connected in quality.**

Our pipelines and systems ensure a high **water quality**. To ensure this in the long term, we also
network pir pipelines digitally. This provides us with important data, such as water temperature or
deviations that need to be regulated. Digital solutions are also used in the **construction
**process. We use Building Information Modelling (BIM) to plan efficiently, proactively and
sustainably.

At Viega, we take care of water quality, digital construction, energy efficiency, comfort and safety
in buildings. In short, we are active in many areas. Our aim is to develop solutions and
technologies that conserve **resources** and improve our **quality of life.**

[ Get to know our fields of expertise ][31]
[ [Viega has officially opened its new production facility in Kirkel, underscoring its commitment to
Germany as a manufacturing location with an investment of around €150 million.]

Sustainability
][33]

As a family company, we have responsibilities to our employees and to the society we live in.
Sustainability, for us, is an integrated corporate task and part of our DNA.

[
Viega Foundation
][34]

The Viega Foundation supports initiatives in India and the USA. The focus is on projects in the area
of water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH).

[
Our Purpose
][35]

Our health relies on the spaces we spend our time in. We turn spaces into living rooms, using
innovative technologies to create places that promote a sense of well-being.

## Who we are

### Employee orientation as a corporate philosophy

AGRU is a success story that has now been going on for eight decades. The company is one of the
world´s most important single-source suppliers for piping systems, semi-finished products, concrete
protective liners and geomembranes made of engineering plastics. We live out a primary goal in terms
of optimised work and general conditions in our daily cooperation. Training and further education
takes high priority. At AGRU, the plastic parts manufacturer, this social component is definitely
the status quo.

## The plastics experts.

### Thermoplastic products for infrastructure, industry, and utilities

AGRU is a leading plastic pipe manufacturer and supplier of high-quality fittings, semi-finished
products, geomembranes and concrete protective liners made from thermoplastic materials. Since its
foundation by Alois Gruber Sr. in 1948 in Upper Austria, AGRU has stood for innovation, operational
reliability, and quality. With our technological expertise and customer-oriented thermoplastic
solutions, we set standards in water, wastewater, energy supply, infrastructure, life sciences and
digitalization.

## Customised Casting Patterns

Customized casting items are used wherever standard components cannot meet the required design,
strength, size, or performance specifications. Foundries manufacture these castings according to
customer drawings, technical specifications, or OEM requirements. **[High Quality Customised Casting
Products such as Engine blocks, cylinder heads, transmission housings, brake drums, flywheels,
steering knuckles, differential housings.][11]**

[Foundry Casting Solutions]
[Castings]


### Customised Auto Castings

Find premium quality **[ Casting Products][12]**. Customized automobile castings are
precision-engineered metal components manufactured according to the exact specifications of
automotive OEMs and Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers. They are used in passenger vehicles, commercial
vehicles, agricultural equipment, construction machinery, electric vehicles (EVs), and off-highway
vehicles.

[Customised Casting Patterns]


### Customised Pump Castings

Explore best quality **[Customised Pumping Casting Patterns][13]**. Customized water pump castings
are precision-engineered components manufactured according to a customer's design, material
specifications, and performance requirements. They are used in various industries where standard
pump parts are not suitable due to operating conditions, pressure, corrosion, or
application-specific needs.

### Foundry - Casting Demand

#### The demand for customized foundry casting products is growing worldwide as manufacturers
#### increasingly require components designed for specific applications rather than standard
#### off-the-shelf castings.

#### Growth is being driven by electric vehicles, industrial automation, renewable energy,
#### infrastructure, mining, oil & gas, and agricultural machinery.

#### Asia-Pacific remains the largest casting market, while Europe and North America continue to
#### demand high-quality, precision-engineered castings for advanced manufacturing.

## Valve Casting Patterns

[Foundry Castings]

### Globe Valve Casting Pattern

The demand for globe valve patterns (patterns used for manufacturing cast globe valve bodies,
bonnets, and related components in foundries) is strong and growing due to increasing investment in
industrial infrastructure, water management, energy, and process industries. Amerigo offers various
range **[Globe Valve Castings][14]**. Globe valve casting sizes in demand are: ½" to 2" – Commercial
plumbing and HVAC 2" to 8" – Water treatment and industrial processing 8" to 24" – Power plants,
refineries, and large infrastructure projects. Pressure classes: Class 150, Class 300, Class 600,
PN16, PN25, PN40.

[Customised Cast products]

### Ball Valve Casting Pattern

The demand for ball valve casting patterns (also called ball valve foundry patterns) is growing
steadily due to increasing demand for industrial valves across sectors such as oil & gas, water
treatment, power generation, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food processing, and HVAC. If your foundry
manufactures customized casting patterns and valve castings, this is a promising market. Explore
high quality **[Premium Quality Ball Valve Castings][15]**. Common Ball Valve Casting Components our
foundries manufacture are : Valve body, Valve bonnet, End caps, Flanges, Gland components, Handle
brackets, Mounting pads Actuator brackets.

# Future Facing Pipeline Infrastructure.

We believe in new ways of doing—at Clover, we do things differently. We work to plan, source and
supply future facing pipeline infrastructure within the water and wastewater industry.

supply future facing pipeline infrastructure within the water and wastewater industry.

### Plan

Clover’s inhouse engineering team combines specialist technical knowledge, creative thinking and
on-the-job experience, to offer our clients a range of project planning and consultation services.

### Source

We harness an extensive global network of product partners to bring our clients the competitive
advantage that comes with choice, quality, availability, and cutting-edge innovation.

LEARN MORE ][114] [

### Supply

In a project based industry, timing is everything. At Clover, our approach to supply and
distribution is based around a dedication to consistency, responsiveness and service excellence.

LEARN MORE ][115]

## We are Clover, an integrated pipeline infrastructure business

Led by a passionate team of industry professionals, we combine strategic project consultation,
product innovation and service excellence. We work with local and global partners to specify
world-leading pipelines across Australia and the Asia Pacific region.

[LEARN MORE][116]

#### Project Case study

### [Future-proofing Port Macquarie’s water quality and supply][117]

Discover how Clover has worked with key government and contractor partners to ensure Port
Macquarie’s burgeoning population has a secure water supply well into the future.

[Read more ][118]
[Lengths of Ductile Iron site next sitting end to end on site.][Lengths of Ductile Iron site next
sitting end to end on site.]

## Capabilities
* ### Mining & Resources
  
  We implement world-leading pipeline solutions for reduced environmental impact, lowered costs, and
  improved results. With a focus on sustainability, we flex from smaller scale commercial mining
  operations to major mines for coal, iron ore, precious metals, lithium, and CSG.
  
  [Read more][119]
* ### Infrastructure
  
  With a proven track record delivering sophisticated solutions for treatment plants, reticulated
  water networks, pump stations, and more to meet the constant demand for larger, more sustainable
  infrastructure, Clover is committed to building Australian communities from the ground up.
  
  [Read more][120]
* ### Land development
  
  Working across sub-divisional and land development projects, Clover supplies the entire spectrum
  of requirements for water, wastewater and stormwater infrastructure with an unparalleled product
  range.
  
  [Read more][121]
* ### Irrigation & Rural
  
  We bring unmatched experience in large scale irrigation projects. Having delivered projects across
  every state and territory—including pipelines, water storage and harvesting, treatment, and
  pumping and infrastructure—Clover pioneers innovative, sustainable ways to support a thriving
  agricultural sector.
  
  [Read more][122]

## We are Clover, an integrated pipeline infrastructure business

Led by a passionate team of industry professionals, we combine strategic project consultation,
product innovation and service excellence. We work with local and global partners to specify
world-leading pipelines across Australia and the Asia Pacific region.

## Capabilities
* ### Mining & Resources
  
  We implement world-leading pipeline solutions for reduced environmental impact, lowered costs, and
  improved results. With a focus on sustainability, we flex from smaller scale commercial mining
  operations to major mines for coal, iron ore, precious metals, lithium, and CSG.
  
  [Read more][119]
* ### Infrastructure
  
  With a proven track record delivering sophisticated solutions for treatment plants, reticulated
  water networks, pump stations, and more to meet the constant demand for larger, more sustainable
  infrastructure, Clover is committed to building Australian communities from the ground up.
  
  [Read more][120]
* ### Land development
  
  Working across sub-divisional and land development projects, Clover supplies the entire spectrum
  of requirements for water, wastewater and stormwater infrastructure with an unparalleled product
  range.
  
  [Read more][121]
* ### Irrigation & Rural
  
  We bring unmatched experience in large scale irrigation projects. Having delivered projects across
  every state and territory—including pipelines, water storage and harvesting, treatment, and
  pumping and infrastructure—Clover pioneers innovative, sustainable ways to support a thriving
  agricultural sector.
  
  [Read more][122]

challenges such as water scarcity, rising labor costs, soil degradation, and the need for higher
crop yields. Traditional irrigation pipelines often suffer from corrosion, leakage, and high
maintenance costs, which can significantly affect productivity and sustainability.

Our Story

## The strength of an elephant.
## The patience of a craftsman.

Gajaant Pipes was started in 2016 by a small family of pipe-extruders in the Ahmednagar MIDC. We
named the company after *gajaant* — Sanskrit for the elephant's tusk — because that's the kind of
strength we wanted our pipes to inherit.

Seventeen years later, we run two extrusion lines, ship to 200+ dealers across India, and have laid
pipes that quietly carry water to villages, factories and farms from Vidarbha to coastal Karnataka.

##### Our Mission

Make trustworthy piping accessible to every farmer, contractor and municipality in India.

##### Our Promise

Virgin compound, IS-stamped batches, and a dealer you can actually call back.

## The patience of a craftsman.

named the company after *gajaant* — Sanskrit for the elephant's tusk — because that's the kind of
strength we wanted our pipes to inherit.

Seventeen years later, we run two extrusion lines, ship to 200+ dealers across India, and have laid
pipes that quietly carry water to villages, factories and farms from Vidarbha to coastal Karnataka.

Bridging Rigid Piping and Flexible Fluid Conveyance in Industrial Networks
][34]

[Deploying a precision ][35][custom chemical hose][36] is a critical engineering strategy for
resolving material compatibility bottlenecks in complex piping networks. While rigid steel, PVC, or
copper pipes form the backbone of industrial fluid transport, they are inherently vulnerable to
mechanical vibration, thermal expansion, and seismic shifts. Integrating flexible conveyance
solutions is essential for maintaining a resilient and leak-free system.

## Material Compatibility in Aggressive Media Transfer

In chemical processing and petrochemical refining, piping systems must handle highly corrosive
acids, bases, and aromatic solvents. Rigid pipes often require expensive exotic alloys to resist
corrosion. However, connecting these rigid segments to moving machinery—such as industrial pumps,
mixing vats, or dispensing arms—requires highly engineered flexible conduits.

Advanced flexible lines utilize ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) or PTFE linings to
achieve near-universal chemical resistance. This ensures that aggressive media can be transferred
safely without leaching compounds into the fluid or degrading the structural integrity of the line,
thereby protecting the broader piping infrastructure.


## Specialized Gas Conveyance and Vibration Attenuation

Beyond liquid transfer, flexible connections play a vital role in isolating high-frequency
vibrations generated by compressors and heavy fabrication equipment. In metalworking and large-scale
manufacturing, the safe delivery of pressurized industrial gases requires robust, color-coded, and
flame-resistant pathways.

For example, integrating a standardized [oem welding hose][37] into a fabrication plant's gas
distribution network ensures safe, twin-line delivery of oxygen and acetylene to the point of use.
Partnering with an advanced supplier for these critical flexible components guarantees that the
entire piping system remains compliant with stringent industrial safety codes while accommodating
the dynamic physical movements of the factory floor.

Bridging Rigid Piping and Flexible Fluid Conveyance in Industrial Networks
][34]

[Deploying a precision ][35][custom chemical hose][36] is a critical engineering strategy for
resolving material compatibility bottlenecks in complex piping networks. While rigid steel, PVC, or
copper pipes form the backbone of industrial fluid transport, they are inherently vulnerable to
mechanical vibration, thermal expansion, and seismic shifts. Integrating flexible conveyance
solutions is essential for maintaining a resilient and leak-free system.

## Material Compatibility in Aggressive Media Transfer

In chemical processing and petrochemical refining, piping systems must handle highly corrosive
acids, bases, and aromatic solvents. Rigid pipes often require expensive exotic alloys to resist
corrosion. However, connecting these rigid segments to moving machinery—such as industrial pumps,
mixing vats, or dispensing arms—requires highly engineered flexible conduits.

Advanced flexible lines utilize ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) or PTFE linings to
achieve near-universal chemical resistance. This ensures that aggressive media can be transferred
safely without leaching compounds into the fluid or degrading the structural integrity of the line,
thereby protecting the broader piping infrastructure.


## Specialized Gas Conveyance and Vibration Attenuation

Beyond liquid transfer, flexible connections play a vital role in isolating high-frequency
vibrations generated by compressors and heavy fabrication equipment. In metalworking and large-scale
manufacturing, the safe delivery of pressurized industrial gases requires robust, color-coded, and
flame-resistant pathways.

For example, integrating a standardized [oem welding hose][37] into a fabrication plant's gas
distribution network ensures safe, twin-line delivery of oxygen and acetylene to the point of use.
Partnering with an advanced supplier for these critical flexible components guarantees that the
entire piping system remains compliant with stringent industrial safety codes while accommodating
the dynamic physical movements of the factory floor.

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### **Where can I buy PPR pipes in the Philippines?**

Jims Enterprises Inc is the leading supplier of PPR pipes in the Philippines, operating for over 20
years. Visit us at **[#888 Gosotto Compound, MJ Cuenco Ave., Mabolo, Cebu City][19]**, or call
**[+63 (917) 892-4580][20]**. We ship and deliver nationwide.

#### **Who is the exclusive distributor of Bugatti Valvosanitaria in the Philippines?**

**Jims Enterprises Inc** is the exclusive distributor of Bugatti Valvosanitaria PPR pipes, fittings,
and valves in the Philippines. Bugatti is 100% Made in Italy and is the top choice for hot and cold
water piping systems among architects and engineers.

#### **What is a PPR pipe and why do architects specify it?**

PPR (Polypropylene Random Copolymer) pipes are used for hot and cold water supply lines in
buildings. Architects and engineers prefer PPR pipes for their heat resistance, durability, and
leak-free fusion-welded joints. Jims Enterprises carries **Bugatti PPR pipes** — the premium Italian
brand trusted across the Philippines.

#### **Where can I buy valves and faucets in Cebu?**

Jims Enterprises Inc carries a complete line of **Bugatti valves and faucets** in Cebu — including
ball valves, gate valves, bibcocks, shower valves, angle valves, foot valves, check valves, and
swing valves. Available for pickup at our Mabolo, Cebu store or delivered nationwide.

#### **Where to buy HDPE pipes and SDR fittings in the Philippines?**

Jims Enterprises Inc supplies **HDPE pipe systems and SDR fittings** across the Philippines. We
carry SDR-9 and SDR-11 HDPE pipes in black and blue variants, from ½" to 6", including a complete
range of compression fittings, couplings, elbows, tees, and saddle clamps.

#### **Where to buy water heaters in the Philippines?**

Jims Enterprises Inc is an authorized **Ferroli water heater** dealer in the Philippines. We carry
electric storage heaters, instant (single-point) water heaters, solar water heaters, and heat pump
water heaters — ideal for residential homes, condominiums, and commercial establishments.

#### **Does Jims Enterprises sell electrical conduit pipes?**

Yes. Jims Enterprises Inc stocks a full range of **electrical PVC conduit pipes** — thinwall (S-20)
and thickwall (S-40) in sizes from ⅜" to 6", plus couplings, elbows, male adapters, junction boxes,
and utility boxes for electrical wiring installations.

#### **Where to buy Unidex PVC pipes in the Philippines?**

**Unidex PVC pipes and fittings** are available through **Jims Enterprises Inc** in the Philippines.
Visit us at **[#888 Gosotto Compound, MJ Cuenco Ave., Mabolo, Cebu City][21]**, or call **[+63 (917)
892-4580][22]**. We deliver nationwide.

#### **Who is the distributor of Unidex PVC pipes in the Philippines?**

**Jims Enterprises Inc** is the distributor of **Unidex PVC pipes** and fittings in the Philippines,
with over 20 years of experience supplying contractors, architects, engineers, and developers across
the country.

#### **What PVC pipes does Jims Enterprises carry?**

Jims Enterprises Inc carries **Unidex PVC pipes** — a complete range including sanitary PVC pipes
(Series 600 and 1000), sewer PVC pipes, in-house blue PVC pipes, pressure line PVC pipes, and orange
PVC piping, all available in various sizes for residential and commercial applications.

#### **Does Jims Enterprises deliver outside Cebu?**

Yes. Jims Enterprises Inc ships and delivers PPR pipes, PVC pipes, HDPE pipes, valves, water
heaters, electrical pipes, and other products to customers **across the Philippines**. Contact us at
[+63 (917) 892-4580][23] or email [jimsenterprises@gmail.com][24] for delivery inquiries.

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### **Where can I buy PPR pipes in the Philippines?**

Jims Enterprises Inc is the leading supplier of PPR pipes in the Philippines, operating for over 20
years. Visit us at **[#888 Gosotto Compound, MJ Cuenco Ave., Mabolo, Cebu City][19]**, or call
**[+63 (917) 892-4580][20]**. We ship and deliver nationwide.

#### **Who is the exclusive distributor of Bugatti Valvosanitaria in the Philippines?**

**Jims Enterprises Inc** is the exclusive distributor of Bugatti Valvosanitaria PPR pipes, fittings,
and valves in the Philippines. Bugatti is 100% Made in Italy and is the top choice for hot and cold
water piping systems among architects and engineers.

#### **What is a PPR pipe and why do architects specify it?**

PPR (Polypropylene Random Copolymer) pipes are used for hot and cold water supply lines in
buildings. Architects and engineers prefer PPR pipes for their heat resistance, durability, and
leak-free fusion-welded joints. Jims Enterprises carries **Bugatti PPR pipes** — the premium Italian
brand trusted across the Philippines.

#### **Where can I buy valves and faucets in Cebu?**

Jims Enterprises Inc carries a complete line of **Bugatti valves and faucets** in Cebu — including
ball valves, gate valves, bibcocks, shower valves, angle valves, foot valves, check valves, and
swing valves. Available for pickup at our Mabolo, Cebu store or delivered nationwide.

#### **Where to buy HDPE pipes and SDR fittings in the Philippines?**

Jims Enterprises Inc supplies **HDPE pipe systems and SDR fittings** across the Philippines. We
carry SDR-9 and SDR-11 HDPE pipes in black and blue variants, from ½" to 6", including a complete
range of compression fittings, couplings, elbows, tees, and saddle clamps.

#### **Where to buy water heaters in the Philippines?**

Jims Enterprises Inc is an authorized **Ferroli water heater** dealer in the Philippines. We carry
electric storage heaters, instant (single-point) water heaters, solar water heaters, and heat pump
water heaters — ideal for residential homes, condominiums, and commercial establishments.

#### **Does Jims Enterprises sell electrical conduit pipes?**

Yes. Jims Enterprises Inc stocks a full range of **electrical PVC conduit pipes** — thinwall (S-20)
and thickwall (S-40) in sizes from ⅜" to 6", plus couplings, elbows, male adapters, junction boxes,
and utility boxes for electrical wiring installations.

#### **Where to buy Unidex PVC pipes in the Philippines?**

**Unidex PVC pipes and fittings** are available through **Jims Enterprises Inc** in the Philippines.
Visit us at **[#888 Gosotto Compound, MJ Cuenco Ave., Mabolo, Cebu City][21]**, or call **[+63 (917)
892-4580][22]**. We deliver nationwide.

#### **Who is the distributor of Unidex PVC pipes in the Philippines?**

**Jims Enterprises Inc** is the distributor of **Unidex PVC pipes** and fittings in the Philippines,
with over 20 years of experience supplying contractors, architects, engineers, and developers across
the country.

#### **What PVC pipes does Jims Enterprises carry?**

Jims Enterprises Inc carries **Unidex PVC pipes** — a complete range including sanitary PVC pipes
(Series 600 and 1000), sewer PVC pipes, in-house blue PVC pipes, pressure line PVC pipes, and orange
PVC piping, all available in various sizes for residential and commercial applications.

#### **Does Jims Enterprises deliver outside Cebu?**

Yes. Jims Enterprises Inc ships and delivers PPR pipes, PVC pipes, HDPE pipes, valves, water
heaters, electrical pipes, and other products to customers **across the Philippines**. Contact us at
[+63 (917) 892-4580][23] or email [jimsenterprises@gmail.com][24] for delivery inquiries.

## FAQs

### Where can I get product & price information?

Upload you drawing in app.madearia.com or e-mail, we will contact you after upon receipt your mail.

### How soon can I get samples and how much the fee?

Depending on your specific project, it usually takes 7 to 15 days. the fee depends on the product
drawing, and the fee will be returned to your bulk order.

### How to enjoy the OEM services?

Usually, base on your design drawings or original samples, we give some technical proposals and a
quotation to you, after your agreement, we produce for you.

### Can you make machining parts based on our samples?

Yes, we can make measurements based on your samples to make drawings for machining parts making.

### Do your materials and processes comply with RoHS, REACH, or other EU standards?

Yes, all our raw materials and manufacturing processes fully comply with RoHS, REACH and relevant EU
regulatory standards.

### What if my parts do not meet the required specifications？

If the finished parts fail to meet your specs, we will revise or remanufacture them free of charge
at our cost until they match your requirements.

## FAQs

### Where can I get product & price information?

Upload you drawing in app.madearia.com or e-mail, we will contact you after upon receipt your mail.

### How soon can I get samples and how much the fee?

Depending on your specific project, it usually takes 7 to 15 days. the fee depends on the product
drawing, and the fee will be returned to your bulk order.

### How to enjoy the OEM services?

Usually, base on your design drawings or original samples, we give some technical proposals and a
quotation to you, after your agreement, we produce for you.

### Can you make machining parts based on our samples?

Yes, we can make measurements based on your samples to make drawings for machining parts making.

### Do your materials and processes comply with RoHS, REACH, or other EU standards?

Yes, all our raw materials and manufacturing processes fully comply with RoHS, REACH and relevant EU
regulatory standards.

### What if my parts do not meet the required specifications？

If the finished parts fail to meet your specs, we will revise or remanufacture them free of charge
at our cost until they match your requirements.

##### Welcome to Our Store

## Our Company History

Metro Tubing Co, trusted name in Pune since 1972. We are manufactures of PVC pipes and sleevings,
authorized dealers for various well-known brands dealing in tools, wielding electrodes, adhesive,
abrasive, and safety products. We started with small trading shop dealing in PVC pipes and over the
years have expanded our portfolio which include Adhesives, Abrasives, Hand tools, Safety gears. We
manufacture PVC pipes, our brand of PVC pipes MetroFlex is one of the top choice for retailers and
consumers in Pune.

Today Metro tubing is authorised dealer for many abrasive, adhesive, hardware, power tools and
brands, to name a few Pidilite (Fevicol / M-Seal), Venus tools, Taparia hand tools, etc. We have
range of over 5000 products, most of which are listed on our website, and we invite you to call us
or visit to find more. Our clients include retailers, some of well-known builders, manufacturing
plants, factories, small scale industries from all over Maharashtra.

Our business is handled by second generation of the founder, but the spirit of the founder to offer
the best services, with most competitive prices has been maintained. Infact with use of technology
we have come closer to our customers, we have tried to simplify the ordering process by taking
orders on phone, email, and even have a dedicated sales team, who go to the retailers to take their
orders.

## Plumbing Costs & Services in Miami — Your Questions Answered

### How much does a plumber cost in Miami?

A standard plumbing repair in Miami typically runs **$150–$450**. Small jobs like clearing a clog or
fixing a leaking faucet are on the lower end; emergency leak detection or water heater work can cost
more. EZ Plumbing always gives upfront pricing before work begins.

### What do most plumbers charge per hour in Florida?

Licensed Florida plumbers typically charge **$70–$150 per hour**, depending on job complexity and
whether it's a standard repair or an after-hours emergency call.

### What are the signs of a good plumber?

A good plumber is fully licensed and insured, arrives on time, gives an honest upfront estimate with
no hidden fees, uses modern diagnostic tools like sewer cameras, and offers a clear workmanship
warranty.

### What is the most common plumbing repair in Miami?

Clogged drains, running toilets, leaking faucets, failing water heaters, and hidden slab leaks
caused by shifting soil and high local water pressure are the most common calls we get.

### Do you charge extra for nights, weekends, or holidays?

**No** — EZ Plumbing provides 24/7 emergency response at the same upfront rate, with no weekend or
after-hours surcharge.

## Why Miami Plumbing Is Different — And What We Watch For

Miami's sandy limestone soil, high water table, and hurricane season create plumbing problems most
other cities never see. Here's what our **licensed Miami plumbers** watch for on every job:
* **Slab Leaks from Limestone Soil** Miami's sandy limestone foundation shifts over time, which can
  crack pipes hidden under the slab — often with no visible warning until water bills spike.
* **Hurricane & Storm Flooding** Heavy rain and storm surge can overload drainage systems and force
  sewage backups — we recommend a backflow check before every hurricane season.
* **Hard Water & Humidity Corrosion** South Florida's humidity and mineral-heavy water accelerate
  corrosion in older pipes and water heaters, shortening their lifespan.
* **Tree Root Intrusion** Miami's tropical landscaping means aggressive root systems that can crack
  or block underground sewer lines over time.

### Which pipe is best for high pressure?

uPVC (unplasticized polyvinyl chloride) pipes are considered to be the best. These pipes offer the
strength and ability to handle high-pressure applications despite being lightweight, like other PVC
types. Their robust construction enables them to withstand significant pressure, making them an
excellent choice for high-pressure piping systems. uPVC pipes are used in various sectors, such as
water distribution systems, agriculture, and other industrial uses.

The report provides an expansive market analysis by covering areas like: growth drivers, trends
prevailing in the industry, Demand-Supply Situation, Foreign Trade, Porters 5 Forces Analysis,
regulatory framework as well as comprehensive SWOT analysis of the sector.

The report further establishes the regulatory framework of the industry. It encapsulates the status
of the current legislation in the industry as well as the recent changes and developments in the
regulations. The report also provides key player profiles along with key financials and comparison.
The market research report shares vital information like shareholding pattern, revenue mix, plant
location and financial summary of the key companies.

[Learn More ][82]
[Market Research Illustration]

#### Industrial Development Technologies & Project Opportunities

Entrepreneur India,  a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) is
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the suitable project for investment. It makes business
decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a list of right projects for investment. Unique among
project investment magazines, 'Entrepreneur India' is dedicated to the business of identifying sound
investment projects. Every issue consists of a new list of projects which are meticulously selected
by the Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team after being screened on various investment
factors. Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team, before labeling a project as 'Right
investment' studies various aspects of investment like product demand, market potential, raw
material availability, suitable location, payback period, costs involved and breakeven point.

[Learn More ][83]
[Entrepreneur India Illustration]

#### Select and Choose the Right Business Startup for You

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

Finding the right startup business is one of the most popular subject today. Starting a business is
no easy endeavour, but the time, effort, and challenges can be worth it if you succeed. To give
yourself the best chance to be successful, take your time to carefully find the right business for
you.

We, at Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS), endeavour to make business selection a simple and
convenient step for any entrepreneur/startup. Our expert team, by capitalizing on its dexterity and
decade's long experience in the field, has created a list of profitable ventures for entrepreneurs
who wish to diversify or venture. The list so mentioned is updated regularly to give you a regular
dose of new emerging opportunities.

[Learn More ][84]
[Startup Selector Illustration]

Present Market Position, Expected Future Demand, Statistics of Imports & Exports, Export Prospect,

List of Plant & Machineries, Miscellaneous Items and Accessories, Instruments, Laboratory

[Land & Building]

#### Land & Building

Requirement of Land Area, Rates of the Land, Built up Area, Construction Schedule, Plant Layout.

[Raw Material]

#### Raw Material

List of Raw Materials, Properties of Raw Materials, Availability of Raw Materials, Required Quality
of Raw Materials, Cost / Rates of Raw Materials.

[Financial Aspects]

Cost of Raw Materials, Cost of Land & Building, Cost of Plant & Machineries, Fixed Capital
Investment, Working Capital, Project Cost, Capital Formation, Cost of Production, Profitability
Analysis, Break Even Point, Cash Flow Statement for 5 to 10 Years, Depreciation Chart, Conclusion,
Projected Balance Sheet, Land Man Ratio.

women entrepreneurs, investors, NRIs, startups, and professionals, providing crucial information on
viable projects. It's the ideal resource for identifying sound investment opportunities.

### About Prakash Pipes

The company’s promoter, Shri Ved Prakash Agarwal, has been in the business of manufacturing PVC
Pipes and Fittings since 1981. Over the years, *Prakash* has emerged as a trusted brand for PVC
Pipes and Fittings in the market, owing to our utmost focus on quality. We manufacture a wide range
of products such as Agri Pipes, Column Pipes, Plumbing Pipes, Casing Pipes, SWR Pipes, Garden Pipes
and their related Fittings. Our products find application in irrigation, drainage, housing, and
sanitation. Our plant at Kashipur, Uttarakhand, is spread across 60 acres of land area, with more
than 50% area being utilized for forestation and plantation.

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. # Global Supplier of Top-Quality Industrial Pipes

With over fifteen years of excellence in manufacturing high-quality piping solutions, Scotto Pipes
is the most trusted name in this field. Specialized in diversified product range comprising Rigid
PVC pipes, UPVC pipes, suction pipes, and garden pipes. Scotto Pipes ensures that all its products
boast superior performance and robust construction. With the most advanced production technology
coupled with the experienced workforce, we ensure all of our finished products are of the highest
grade. It is what drives innovation, making us a leader in exports, as we serve clients all over the
world with reliable piping solutions that cater specifically to their needs, available in various
sizes to suit any application.

The right piping system really contributes to any project type such as residential, commercial, and
agricultural. Scotto Pipes Rigid PVC and UPVC pipes are set for longevity with high corrosion
resistance and a long useful life that makes them excellent for variety of applications. Our suction
and garden pipes ensure unmatched functionality in operation. With commitment to satisfaction for
customers, sustainability of practices, and a global reach, Scotto Pipes is the source of excellence
dedicated to making us your partner of choice for all your piping needs.

## Supreme Milestones

[MILESTONES][58]

## 1942

8 decades ago, as India fought for independence, a group of enterprising promoters laid the
foundation for a new venture. The Modi family established Supreme Industries Limited to produce and
market various products.

## 1942-1966

The company started to bloom as its turnover reached 18.77 lakh rupees in 1965-66 which is
equivalent to today's 40 CR. In August 1966, Supreme's management was taken over by the Taparia
family who defined the field of plastic processing as the company's core business.

## 1966-1980

Supreme soon opened the floodgates of development and expansion, transforming the company into a
leading powerhouse in the realm of plastic products, pioneering the manufacture of 'Satranj' PP
mats, PVC pipes, HMHDPE film and bags, and injection moulded plastic products. In 1974, the company
started manufacturing units at Andheri & Taloja

## 1981-1990

During 1981-82, the Taloja unit began producing polyethylene foam. Soon after, Supreme collaborated
with Rasmussen Polymer Development AG, Switzerland to set up Siltap Chemicals Ltd. to manufacture
cross laminated films. The company started spreading its roots across the nation with new
manufacturing units in Jalgaon (PVC pipes and fittings) and Noida (IPD). In 1989-90, the Group
crossed the landmark milestone of Rs 100 crore sales turnover and also opened a state-of-the-art
Technology Centre at Goregaon, Mumbai.

## 1991-2000

Supreme scaled high and wide - from pioneering new product verticals such as plastic moulded
furniture, thermoformed food service ware, crates, multilayer sheets, BOPP films and non crosslinked
PE foam products to establishing new manufacturing units in Daman, Puducherry, Malanpur, Silvassa
and Kolkata. Furthermore, the company reached unprecedented heights through major acquisitions and
joint ventures. Supreme became the first Indian corporation in the plastic sector to accomplish ISO
14002/ISO 9002 Certification and ISO 9001 Certification, paving the way for another defining decade.

## 2001-2010

The cruise of expansion continued for Supreme with 7 new manufacturing plants. At the start of the
decade, 5 new plants came up in Punjab, Rajasthan, Assam, U.P., and West Bengal which marked
Supreme’s PAN India presence. Following this, in 2007-08 Supreme built a 132-acre mega-complex to
produce diverse plastic products in Gadegaon, Maharashtra. Thereafter, Supreme started a production
unit at Urse near Pune for protective packaging products. With projects of such a magnum scale,
Supreme set things in motion for a golden decade.

## 2011-2015

Supreme established a one-of-a-kind ‘Knowledge Centre’ to train plumbing professionals. The company
also built Supreme Chambers, a Platinum Rated Green Building in Andheri. Supreme started its
manufacturing units in Chennai and Noida for industrial products & Hosur for protective packaging
products. The company also revamped the Malanpur Plant & built extensive facilities at the Gadegaon
Plant in Maharashtra. Supreme achieved two milestones in the year 2014-15. First, Supreme secured
exclusive global rights to produce and market cross laminated film products. Second, the company
also began commercial production of composite cylinders in Halol, Gujarat.

## 2016-2020

Supreme established two new multi-product mega complexes – the first one was at Kharagpur (West
Bengal), spread across 59 Acres and another one was at Jadcherla (Telangana), spread across 50
acres. Meanwhile, the company also established a new facility in Giloth (Rajasthan) for the
production of industrial moulded products. Supreme also expanded its facilities in Kanpur and Hosur.
The company started manufacturing new product lines like water tanks, blow moulded furniture &
rotomoulded products.

## 2021 onwards...

In the new decade, Supreme initiated three greenfield projects in Guwahati, Cuttack & Erode, paving
the way for deeper penetration across India. With net revenue of 7841 CR in 2021-22, Supreme's
journey only seems to escalate moving forward. Supreme has also taken up many sustainability
initiatives in terms of manufacturing processes that will reduce its carbon footprints.

## Sustainability

With an all-encompassing goal of driving change for the betterment of society, Supreme has always
made choices that nurture and protect the environment.

The company strives to reduce carbon emissions in its operations by increasing the use of renewable
energy and low-carbon fuels.

[Know More][59]

It is indeed every company's responsibility to make changes and choices that benefit the
environment. Hence as a company, we aim to foster an environment-first culture in the future as
well.

Intending to give back to society that we benefit so much from, Supreme Foundation has taken several

Every Supreme product is not just made to be consumed but designed to create an Impact. Hence,

## Supreme Milestones

[MILESTONES][58]

## 1942

8 decades ago, as India fought for independence, a group of enterprising promoters laid the
foundation for a new venture. The Modi family established Supreme Industries Limited to produce and
market various products.

## 1942-1966

The company started to bloom as its turnover reached 18.77 lakh rupees in 1965-66 which is
equivalent to today's 40 CR. In August 1966, Supreme's management was taken over by the Taparia
family who defined the field of plastic processing as the company's core business.

## 1966-1980

Supreme soon opened the floodgates of development and expansion, transforming the company into a
leading powerhouse in the realm of plastic products, pioneering the manufacture of 'Satranj' PP
mats, PVC pipes, HMHDPE film and bags, and injection moulded plastic products. In 1974, the company
started manufacturing units at Andheri & Taloja

## 1981-1990

During 1981-82, the Taloja unit began producing polyethylene foam. Soon after, Supreme collaborated
with Rasmussen Polymer Development AG, Switzerland to set up Siltap Chemicals Ltd. to manufacture
cross laminated films. The company started spreading its roots across the nation with new
manufacturing units in Jalgaon (PVC pipes and fittings) and Noida (IPD). In 1989-90, the Group
crossed the landmark milestone of Rs 100 crore sales turnover and also opened a state-of-the-art
Technology Centre at Goregaon, Mumbai.

## 1991-2000

Supreme scaled high and wide - from pioneering new product verticals such as plastic moulded
furniture, thermoformed food service ware, crates, multilayer sheets, BOPP films and non crosslinked
PE foam products to establishing new manufacturing units in Daman, Puducherry, Malanpur, Silvassa
and Kolkata. Furthermore, the company reached unprecedented heights through major acquisitions and
joint ventures. Supreme became the first Indian corporation in the plastic sector to accomplish ISO
14002/ISO 9002 Certification and ISO 9001 Certification, paving the way for another defining decade.

## 2001-2010

The cruise of expansion continued for Supreme with 7 new manufacturing plants. At the start of the
decade, 5 new plants came up in Punjab, Rajasthan, Assam, U.P., and West Bengal which marked
Supreme’s PAN India presence. Following this, in 2007-08 Supreme built a 132-acre mega-complex to
produce diverse plastic products in Gadegaon, Maharashtra. Thereafter, Supreme started a production
unit at Urse near Pune for protective packaging products. With projects of such a magnum scale,
Supreme set things in motion for a golden decade.

## 2011-2015

Supreme established a one-of-a-kind ‘Knowledge Centre’ to train plumbing professionals. The company
also built Supreme Chambers, a Platinum Rated Green Building in Andheri. Supreme started its
manufacturing units in Chennai and Noida for industrial products & Hosur for protective packaging
products. The company also revamped the Malanpur Plant & built extensive facilities at the Gadegaon
Plant in Maharashtra. Supreme achieved two milestones in the year 2014-15. First, Supreme secured
exclusive global rights to produce and market cross laminated film products. Second, the company
also began commercial production of composite cylinders in Halol, Gujarat.

## 2016-2020

Supreme established two new multi-product mega complexes – the first one was at Kharagpur (West
Bengal), spread across 59 Acres and another one was at Jadcherla (Telangana), spread across 50
acres. Meanwhile, the company also established a new facility in Giloth (Rajasthan) for the
production of industrial moulded products. Supreme also expanded its facilities in Kanpur and Hosur.
The company started manufacturing new product lines like water tanks, blow moulded furniture &
rotomoulded products.

## 2021 onwards...

In the new decade, Supreme initiated three greenfield projects in Guwahati, Cuttack & Erode, paving
the way for deeper penetration across India. With net revenue of 7841 CR in 2021-22, Supreme's
journey only seems to escalate moving forward. Supreme has also taken up many sustainability
initiatives in terms of manufacturing processes that will reduce its carbon footprints.

## Sustainability

With an all-encompassing goal of driving change for the betterment of society, Supreme has always
made choices that nurture and protect the environment.

The company strives to reduce carbon emissions in its operations by increasing the use of renewable
energy and low-carbon fuels.

[Know More][59]

It is indeed every company's responsibility to make changes and choices that benefit the
environment. Hence as a company, we aim to foster an environment-first culture in the future as
well.

## In Little Ways

Intending to give back to society that we benefit so much from, Supreme Foundation has taken several

education, healthcare support, financial provisions for the underprivileged and development programs
in many villages, Supreme plays its part in creating a better, brighter world for our future

## Innovating Products, Creating Impact

[Supreme Impact][61]

Every Supreme product is not just made to be consumed but designed to create an Impact. Hence,
Supreme has become a name of choice in every Indian household for quality and innovative plastic
products. Our diverse product portfolio brings convenience, accessibility, affordability and, most
importantly, adds value to everyday life.

## Awards & Accolades

Supreme has become the industry standard in the plastics industry over the years. We do nothing less
than the best when it comes to creating products with the highest process and quality standards.
Hence, our organisation has received awards, accolades and recognition at global levels.

## **About Us**

# **Truflo Pipes Delivering Plumbing Solutions for all Your Plastic Water Pipes Requirements**

Truflo Pipes is one of the leading Pipes and Fittings Manufacturers and suppliers of superior
quality pipes and fittings. Truflo offers a wide range of pipes and fittings in [CPVC][52],
[UPVC][53], [SWR][54] and [PVC][55]. As one of the best plastic pipes manufacturers, we commit to
delivering the best quality pipes for our customers at competitive prices and ensure timely delivery
to meet their requirements on time.

With a good experience in the piping industry, we have witnessed the strong fundamentals for growth
in the pipe industry. Truflo Pipes has observed growth to superior quality management practices
which resulted in an increase in sales. We serve our customers with utmost sincerity and believe in
gaining their trust as the basis for a long-lasting relationship. Some of the key contributors to
our success are outstanding competence, excellent team spirit and visionary management.

Our state-of-the-art products and services are in compliance with the set industry standards and
help meet industrial requirements and solve water management challenges. Our plastic water pipes and
other plumbing products are sent through thorough quality testing to ensure they sustain different
water pressures.

Our sprawling factory is located in Hyderabad, Telangana. As a leading plastic pipes manufacturer,
our plastic pipes manufacturing unit is equipped with top-notch pipe extrusion plant supported by a
team of highly experienced professionals. As a result, we are capable of supplying a large number of
plastic water pipes and other related products. Our machinery & equipment incorporate the latest
technologies which enable us to be competitive pipes and fittings manufacturers in the market.

## **Delivering superior quality pipes and fittings for a diverse range of applications**

Our products are manufactured strictly according to the ISI and other international standards. We
redefine our quality standards periodically, which lets us deliver more quality and valued products
to last-line users. Our wide range plumbing solutions are used in transportation of Portable Water,
Gases, Distribution Lines, Electrical/Telecom Ducting, Chemicals, Sewerage/Drainage lines, Waste
Disposal, Borewells, Irrigation and Sprinkler Systems. Truflo Pipes also maintains an inventory of
quality pipes and fittings and plumbing solutions to provide customers with a one-stop solution for
all their plumbing requirements. We are constantly growing and hope to be available for our
customers through our distribution and services PAN India.

## **About Us**

# **Truflo Pipes Delivering Plumbing Solutions for all Your Plastic Water Pipes Requirements**

Truflo Pipes is one of the leading Pipes and Fittings Manufacturers and suppliers of superior
quality pipes and fittings. Truflo offers a wide range of pipes and fittings in [CPVC][52],
[UPVC][53], [SWR][54] and [PVC][55]. As one of the best plastic pipes manufacturers, we commit to
delivering the best quality pipes for our customers at competitive prices and ensure timely delivery
to meet their requirements on time.

With a good experience in the piping industry, we have witnessed the strong fundamentals for growth
in the pipe industry. Truflo Pipes has observed growth to superior quality management practices
which resulted in an increase in sales. We serve our customers with utmost sincerity and believe in
gaining their trust as the basis for a long-lasting relationship. Some of the key contributors to
our success are outstanding competence, excellent team spirit and visionary management.

Our state-of-the-art products and services are in compliance with the set industry standards and
help meet industrial requirements and solve water management challenges. Our plastic water pipes and
other plumbing products are sent through thorough quality testing to ensure they sustain different
water pressures.

Our sprawling factory is located in Hyderabad, Telangana. As a leading plastic pipes manufacturer,
our plastic pipes manufacturing unit is equipped with top-notch pipe extrusion plant supported by a
team of highly experienced professionals. As a result, we are capable of supplying a large number of
plastic water pipes and other related products. Our machinery & equipment incorporate the latest
technologies which enable us to be competitive pipes and fittings manufacturers in the market.

## **Delivering superior quality pipes and fittings for a diverse range of applications**

Our products are manufactured strictly according to the ISI and other international standards. We
redefine our quality standards periodically, which lets us deliver more quality and valued products
to last-line users. Our wide range plumbing solutions are used in transportation of Portable Water,
Gases, Distribution Lines, Electrical/Telecom Ducting, Chemicals, Sewerage/Drainage lines, Waste
Disposal, Borewells, Irrigation and Sprinkler Systems. Truflo Pipes also maintains an inventory of
quality pipes and fittings and plumbing solutions to provide customers with a one-stop solution for
all their plumbing requirements. We are constantly growing and hope to be available for our
customers through our distribution and services PAN India.

# WESTERN AG IS A NAME YOU CAN TRUST.

With over 40 years of experience in the agricultural irrigation and [PVC pipe][15] manufacturing
sectors, Western Ag has the experience to make sure your [agriculture][16] or [construction][17]
project is fitted with the finest and most appropriate pipes for the job.
CONTACT US
[PVC Pipe, Home]

# AMERICAN MADE PVC PIPES WITH AMERICAN VALUES

As it stands today, Western Ag is one of the very few American-owned plastic pipe manufacturers and
distributors left in the country. We hold onto our roots proudly. Every pipe and PVC product
produced at Western AG is done so by the hands of our [qualified team of dedicated workers][18].

Our motto is “Quality People, Better Products”, and we strive to achieve that every single day.

## TYPES OF PVC PIPING WE OFFER

At Western Ag, we produce [PVC pipes][19] for the agriculture and construction sectors. These two
independent industries require different types of piping for different functions.

PVC can get the job done if you are looking for a crush-resistant jacket pipe, HVAC ductwork, or
durable, long-lasting irrigation pipes.

[PVC Pipe, Home]

## Agriculture Pipes

For agriculture, we manufacture and supply four distinct PVC products. Underground irrigation pipes,
UV pivot pipes (under sling pipe), and well shroud. Each of these products is crafted with care and
expertise, guaranteed to serve their duty for years to come.

###### [Learn More about our Agriculture PVC products here.][20]

[PVC Pipe, Home]

## Construction Pipes

In construction, PVC has several applications. These include HVAC ductwork, jacket pipe, and sleeve.
Is PVC HVAC ductwork right for your construction project? You might be surprised at the benefits of
PVC ductwork, and its affordable price point compared to traditional thin metal piping.

###### [Learn More about PVC in Construction here.][21]

### QUESTION, COMMENTS, OR READY TO GET STARTED?

Have questions that have not been answered on our website? We would love to hear from you and help
you get started in selecting exactly what you need for your next agriculture or construction
endeavor.

Fill out the form below, or send us an email.

We look forward to speaking with your soon.

We, Wonder Agritech Pvt. Ltd., an ISO 9001:2015 accredited company, with A-1 rating by CRISIL is a
renowned name of the firm. We laid down our business formation stone in the year 1998 and since then

company is leading the domain as a manufacturer, supplier, trader, importer and exporter of PVC Agri

the domain. Under the observation of an experienced quality inspecting team, our product-line is
